_readme: Sumber kebenaran status fitur BantuKuliah. AI/dev: sebelum klaim fitur 'jalan', baca file ini. live-proven WAJIB ada evidence. Update = bagian DoD tiap perubahan.

auto_absen_simkuliah_usk.evidence: absen_state.json: SINF2009 sukses 7 Okt (Dezz), SINF2023 sukses 8 Okt 16:43/16:44 WIB (Dezz+Rizki); cron absen-watcher-dezz + absen_gate.py
auto_absen_simkuliah_usk.note: POST konfirmasi_kehadiran langsung (bypass SweetAlert), captcha ddddocr, login via vault. Multi-akun terbukti.
auto_absen_simkuliah_usk.saas_gap: perlu porting ke multi-tenant: state per-user, browser isolation per-user, jadwal dari fetch SIMKULIAH bukan file statis

monitor_tugas_moodle.evidence: state.json dedupe entries moodle_assign_*; cron monitor-tugas-dezz 4x/hari; evidence/moodle_dashboard_*.png

monitor_tugas_moodle.saas_gap: per-user Moodle credentials + dedupe di DB

monitor_tugas_google_classroom.note: pernah jalan via sesi browser tersimpan, 2 akun; saat ini BLOCKED — butuh re-login manual/OAuth flow
monitor_tugas_google_classroom.saas_gap: butuh OAuth flow resmi; sesi browser tidak scalable untuk SaaS

captcha_solver_pipeline.evidence: saas/py/captcha_solver.py ada + ddddocr terinstal di .venv-captcha + terbukti dipakai flow absen live

scheduler_window_gate.evidence: scripts/absen_gate.py + check_schedule.py dipakai cron produksi; output 'idle' di luar window
